description:
Surface the AI-engine prompts where competitor domains were URL-cited in this site's audit history but the site was NOT — for one competitor, or every competitor on the site at once. Covers the site's audits and those run through the MCP for its domain (check_brand_citation, get_share_of_voice, rechecks).

Billing: 5¢ per call — one run whether it covers one competitor or all of them. Not billed when the site_id or competitor_domain is rejected, the scan fails, or the window has no answered checks to scan (total_prompts_scanned 0, charged_cents 0).

When to call: 'what is <competitor> getting cited on that we're not', 'where are we losing to <competitor>', 'which competitors beat us in AI answers'. For every competitor, omit competitor_domain rather than calling once per competitor.

Inputs: site_id (from list_sites); competitor_domain — optional, one of the site's competitor_domains (list_sites shows them); window_days — optional, default 30 (7–365).

Returns with competitor_domain: { rows: [{prompt, engines_competitor_cited_on, last_cited_at, leverage}], total_prompts_scanned, competitor_domain, window_days, generated_at, charged_cents }.
Without it: { competitors: [{competitor_domain, prompts_won, high_leverage, engines}] ranked by prompts_won, rows: [{prompt, competitors_cited, competitor_count, engines_competitor_cited_on, last_cited_at, user_brand_mentioned, leverage}] widest losses first, competitor_domains, total_prompts_scanned, window_days, generated_at, charged_cents }.
leverage: 'high_leverage' when the brand was named in the answer but not URL-cited (closest gap to close), 'pure_loss' when neither. A competitor_domain not on the site returns competitor_not_on_site with valid_competitor_domains.

Example: { site_id: "...", competitor_domain: "asana.com", window_days: 30 } — or { site_id: "..." } for all competitors.

competitor_domain.description: One of the site's competitor_domains (see list_sites). Omit to analyze every competitor on the site in one 5¢ run.

name: mine_competitor_prompts
title: Find prompts where competitors are winning citations and you're not
